description: Ed Markey is the Democratic nominee. Joe Tache, running as a third party candidate with the Party for Socialism and Liberation, will be challenging him this November 3rd. He is on the path to the general election having raised $270,995.84 with no corporate money and no PAC money — and polling at 7%,

title: Socialist Joe Tache On General Election Against Ed Markey: "A Vote for Ed Markey Is a Vote for the Status Quo" — Joe Tache for U.S. Senate
